description: Configure AdButler with an existing API key. Use this if the user already has an AdButler account and API key. Note: this configures the key for the current session only. For a persistent connection, the user should instead put the key in their MCP connection settings (an "Authorization: Bearer" header, or "?api_key=" appended to the server URL) — prefer suggesting that before asking the user to share their key in chat.
name: setup_api_key
